name: Fat Pack Preroll | Flight of the Concord
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. Grape Gas x I-95 make up Flight of the Concords, a juicy grape-forward strain with floral hints. Euphoric, mood-lifting, and slightly sedative, it’s ideal for unwinding into the weekend. Terpenes like Linalool, Myrcene, and Pinene add balance to its profile.
